decision_note: HathiTrust catalogs the SEP pamphlet as 1925, while recent UAA scholarship cites an archival copy as Publicaciones de la SEP Tomo III Núm. 18, 1926, p. 5. PDHD retains 1925 as the working catalog year but preserves the 1926 citation as a possible issue/reprint/imprint discrepancy pending direct inspection of the historical object.

The UNAM-RI digital object is dated 1 January 1889, while a historical study reports that México Intelectual began operating on 16 January 1889. PDHD preserves the UNAM-RI object date as catalog metadata but treats the inaugural chronology at month precision until the original imprint is directly inspected.

Peer-reviewed Signos Históricos identifies the Internet Archive object as tomo 2, núm. 3 (1922), while a UNAM thesis cites Gabriela Mistral's contribution in diciembre de 1921. A new direct inspection of Internet Archive's OCR derivative for the scanned primary volume exposes an issue-opening imprint reading MEXICO, DICIEMBRE DE 1921 and therefore materially strengthens the 1921-12 side of the conflict. Because OCR is not equivalent to image-verified text, PDHD does not silently overwrite the catalog year yet; the next gate is direct inspection of the corresponding page image/imprint.
